data.title: About Yevgeniya
bio: With a strong foundation in customer service and sales spanning over two decades, I bring a people-first approach to real estate.  Based in Howell, NJ, and serving clients across Central and South Jersey, I combine market knowledge with genuine care to guide buyers and sellers through every step of their real estate journey.  Since entering the industry in 2023, I have built my business on trust, communication, and professionalism.

Backed by a team of seasoned experts, many of whom have earned the prestigious Circle of Excellence Award multiple times.  I provide each client with the insight, support, and confidence needed to make sound real estate decisions.  Whether you're buying your first home, selling a property, or exploring investment opportunities, I am dedicated to helping you achieve your goals with ease and peace of mind.
Let's connect to talk about your next move!  GeniyaHasTheKeys@gmail.
